import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_88/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_88/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_88/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_88/training_3.csv"
]

# Load all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
dfs = [pd.read_csv(path, index_col=0) for path in source_files]

# According to operation_history: UNION of all source tables on TrackID column
# All source tables have the same schema, so union is valid
# We only keep the 'TrackID' column as per target schema

# Concatenate all dataframes vertically (union)
union_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Select only the 'TrackID' column
target_df = union_df[['TrackID']]

# Ensure 'TrackID' column is integer type as per target schema
target_df['TrackID'] = target_df['TrackID'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target CSV file without the index column
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_88/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
